item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"waiting_depth","expression":"len(self.waiting)","rationale":"Queue size captures variation in priority-queue insertion and allocation costs."},{"name":"heap_height","expression":"0 if len(self.waiting) == 0 else (1 if len(self.waiting) < 3 else (2 if len(self.waiting) < 7 else 3))","rationale":"Gives the maximum sift-up distance for the fixed workload's queue sizes of zero through seven."},{"name":"incoming_priority","expression":"request.priority","rationale":"Incoming priority influences comparisons and movement during heap insertion."}],"hypothesis":"The workload adds new requests to a priority queue; insertion depth and incoming priority should explain its main instruction-count variation."}
